boolean-output-without-value-or-probabil.why: A boolean decision output must carry a boolean value or a probability_true; with both null the decision cannot be replayed (R1).

choice-selected-free-text.json.why: selected is an option ID with no whitespace, so the decision model's free-text answer can never be stored (C2).

classifier-in-live-mode.json.why: Classifier routes are shadow-only in v1 and must never change what is sent upstream (8.1, R2).

decision-model-without-output.json.why: A recorded decision model must come with its structured output, or replay cannot reproduce the chosen target (8.5 change 1, R1).

feature-evidence-estimated.json.why: Input features are read from or derived exactly from the request, so their evidence is measured, inferred, or unavailable, never estimated.

free-text-rationale-property.json.why: The decision output is a closed object, so a free-text rationale from the decision model has nowhere to go (C2).

harness-hook-in-live-mode.json.why: Harness-hook recommendations are shadow-only in v1, even on a route type that may be live at the proxy (8.2).

input-feature-outside-closed-set.json.why: The v0 feature set is closed: adding a feature is a schema change, so a feature can never smuggle in text (8.2).

output-without-decision-model.json.why: An output with no recorded decision model has no pinned model ID or version to replay against (8.5 changes 1 and 2).

probability-above-one.json.why: A probability is an exact decimal string in [0, 1]; 1.5 is out of range.

probability-as-json-float.json.why: Probabilities are exact-decimal strings, never JSON floats, so replay compares the same exact value everywhere.

random-split-without-arm.json.why: Arms are compared per episode (8.4); without the arm, two arms that pick the same model are indistinguishable.

stage-route-in-live-mode.json.why: Stage routes are shadow-only in v1; only passthrough and tier-alias routes change traffic (8.1, R2).

unavailable-feature-given-as-zero.json.why: An unavailable feature is null with a reason, never zero, so a missing signal cannot read as a measured zero.

workagent-episode-missing-run-id.json.why: A WorkAgent episode is the assignment and the run together; without run_id, acceptance cannot be attributed to it (8.4).
